Description
Acuity is seeking a Software Engineer I to implement and maintain software applications that support our business operations. This role leverages modern programming languages and frameworks to develop secure, efficient, and user-focused solutions. The Software Engineer I collaborates with engineers and business analysts in an agile environment, follows development best practices to deliver timely, high-quality solutions, and troubleshoots production issues while providing technical support as needed.
 
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Collaborate with mentor, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into effective software solutions.
Maintain integrity and excellence in your work. Proactively seeking out, constructive feedback to foster continuous learning and development.
Enhance and maintain software applications by resolving bugs, rolling out new features, and optimizing performance with the guidance of a mentor.
Write clean and maintainable code under the guidance of a mentor.
Perform testing and debugging to ensure code quality, stability, and performance across environments.
Start to partake in the nightly call list for problem resolution with the assistance and guidance of your mentor.
Participate in regular and predictable attendance and complete mandatory training programs as determined by Acuity.
Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent of education and experience in software engineering, computer science or related field.

EXPERIENCE:

Entry level 0-2 years with relevant internship experience preferred.

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with a range of tools and technologies, including:
Languages: Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or COBOL, etc.
 Relational or non-relational databases and related tools, such as Db2, MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, DataStage, Erwin, etc.
 WebUI frameworks, such as Angular, React, Vue.
Version control tools, such as Git.
 Testing tools and frameworks, such as JUnit, Bruno, Postman.
 Strong analytical thinker with the ability to break down simple problems and identify practical solutions.
 Excellent communicator and team player, skilled at working with cross-functional teams.
 Capable of undertaking development tasks under the guidance of a mentor.
 Experience in creating and updating documentation, test plans, and disaster recovery procedures.
 Passion for delivering high-quality and reliable results.

*Acuity does not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization.* 

This job is classified as exempt. 

For this role, Acuity offers a comprehensive benefits package, including a generous 401(k) contribution, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, and more. A full description of benefits and eligibility will be provided to candidates during the hiring process.
